entries.title: John 1:1
segments: In the Beginning the Word was; and the Word was with God; and the Word was God.

entries.title: John 1:2
segments: He was in the Beginning with God;

entries.title: John 1:3
segments: Through him all things came into being, and nothing came into being apart from him.

entries.title: John 1:4
segments: That which came into being in him was Life; and the Life was the Light of Man;

entries.title: John 1:5
segments: And the Light shines in the darkness, and the darkness never overpowered it.

entries.title: John 1:6
segments: There appeared a man sent from God, whose name was John;

entries.title: John 1:7
segments: He came as a witness--to bear witness to the Light that through him all men might believe.

entries.title: John 1:8
segments: He was not the Light, but he came to bear witness to the Light.

entries.title: John 1:9
segments: That was the True Light which enlightens every man coming into the world.

entries.title: John 1:10
segments: He was in the world; and through him the world came into being--yet the world did not know him.

entries.title: John 1:11
segments: He came to his own--yet his own did not receive him.

entries.title: John 1:12
segments: But to all who did receive him he gave power to become Children of God--to those who believe in his Name.

entries.title: John 1:13
segments: For not to natural conception, nor to human instincts, nor to will of man did they owe the new Life, but to God.

entries.title: John 1:14
segments: And the Word became Man, and dwelt among us, (We saw his glory--the glory of the Only Son sent from the Father), full of love and truth.

entries.title: John 1:15
segments: (John bears witness to him; he cried aloud--for it was he who spoke--"'He who is Coming' after me is now before me, for he was ever first");

entries.title: John 1:16
segments: Out of his fullness we have all received some gift, gift after gift of love;

entries.title: John 1:17
segments: For the Law was given through Moses, love and truth came through Jesus Christ.

entries.title: John 1:18
segments: No man has ever yet seen God; God the Only Son, who is ever with the Father--He has revealed him.

entries.title: John 1:19
segments: When the Jews sent some Priests and Levites to John from Jerusalem, to ask--"Who are you?", his statement was this:

entries.title: John 1:20
segments: He confessed and did not deny it, he confessed--"I am not the Christ."

entries.title: John 1:21
segments: "What then?" they asked. "Are you Elijah?" "No," he said, "I am not." "Are you 'the Prophet'?" He answered, "No."

entries.title: John 1:22
segments: "Who then are you?" they continued; "tell us, that we may have some answer to give to those who have sent us. What do you say about yourself?"

entries.title: John 1:23
segments: "I," he answered, "am--'The voice of one crying aloud in the Wilderness--"straighten the way of the Lord"', as the Prophet Isaiah said."

entries.title: John 1:24
segments: These men had been sent from the Pharisees;

entries.title: John 1:25
segments: And their next question was: "Why then do you baptize, if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor yet 'the Prophet'?"

entries.title: John 1:26
segments: John's answer was--"I baptize with water, but among you stands one whom you do not know;

entries.title: John 1:27
segments: He is coming after me, yet I am not worthy even to unfasten his sandal."

entries.title: John 1:28
segments: All this took place at Bethany, across the Jordan, where John was then baptizing.

entries.title: John 1:29
segments: The next day John saw Jesus coming towards him, and exclaimed: "Here is the Lamb of God, who is to take away the sin of the world!

entries.title: John 1:30
segments: It was of him that I spoke when I said 'After me there is coming a man who is now before me, for he was ever First.'

entries.title: John 1:31
segments: I myself did not know him, but, that he may be made known to Israel, I have come, baptizing with water."

entries.title: John 1:32
segments: John also made this statement--"I have seen the Spirit descending as a dove out of the heavens, and it remained upon him.

entries.title: John 1:33
segments: I myself did not know him, but he who sent me to baptize with water, he said to me 'He upon whom you see the Spirit descending, and remaining upon him--he it is who baptizes with the Holy Spirit.'

entries.title: John 1:34
segments: This I have seen myself, and I have declared my belief that he is the Son of God."

entries.title: John 1:35
segments: The next day, when John was standing with two of his disciples,

entries.title: John 1:36
segments: He looked at Jesus as he passed and exclaimed: "There is the Lamb of God!"

entries.title: John 1:37
segments: The two disciples heard him say this, and followed Jesus.

entries.title: John 1:38
segments: But Jesus turned round, and saw them following. "What are you looking for?" he asked. "Rabbi," they answered (or, as we should say, "Teacher"), "where are you staying?"

entries.title: John 1:39
segments: "Come, and you shall see," he replied. So they went, and saw where he was staying, and spent that day with him. It was then about four in the afternoon.

entries.title: John 1:40
segments: One of the two, who heard what John said and followed Jesus, was Andrew, Simon Peter's brother.

entries.title: John 1:41
segments: He first found his own brother Simon, and said to him: "We have found the Messiah!" (a word which means 'Christ,' or 'Consecrated'.)

entries.title: John 1:42
segments: Then he brought him to Jesus. Fixing his eyes on him, Jesus said: "You are Simon, the son of John; you shall be called Kephas" (which means 'Peter,' or 'Rock').

entries.title: John 1:43
segments: The following day Jesus decided to leave for Galilee. He found Philip, and said to him: "Follow me."

entries.title: John 1:44
segments: Philip was from Bethsaida, and a fellow-townsman of Andrew and Peter.

entries.title: John 1:45
segments: He found Nathanael and said to him: "We have found him of whom Moses wrote in the Law, and of whom the Prophets also wrote--Jesus of Nazareth, Joseph's son!"

entries.title: John 1:46
segments: "Can anything good come out of Nazareth?" asked Nathanael. "Come and see," replied Philip.

entries.title: John 1:47
segments: When Jesus saw Nathanael coming towards him, he said: "Here is a true Israelite, in whom there is no deceit!"

entries.title: John 1:48
segments: "How do you know me?" asked Nathanael. "Even before Philip called you," replied Jesus, "when you were under the fig tree, I saw you."

entries.title: John 1:49
segments: "Rabbi," Nathanael exclaimed, "you are the Son of God, you are King of Israel!"

entries.title: John 1:50
segments: "Do you believe in me," asked Jesus, "because I told you that I saw you under the fig tree? You shall see greater things than those!

entries.title: John 1:51
segments: In truth I tell you," he added, "you shall all see Heaven open, and 'the angels of God ascending and descending' upon the Son of Man."
